visualRisks.description: Potential confusion at the dock area
visualRisks.details: The dock is marked in a different color (#98734e) compared to the ground, which might cause visual confusion. The contrast between these colors could be improved for better clarity.
Some houses are placed closer together than others, which might make the layout appear less organized or intentional. This could be adjusted to ensure a more uniform distribution of buildings.

navigationRisks.description: Potential navigation issues near the water's edge
navigationRisks.details: The route path (15,27,16,28...) seems to approach the water's edge closely. Users might find it difficult to navigate through this area due to the limited space and potential obstacles.

navigationRisks.description: Route may be too complex for some users
navigationRisks.details: The route involves a series of small steps (15,27,16,28...), which could be confusing or difficult to follow. Simplifying the path might improve user experience.
